overview: 世界模型尝试从观察和行动中学会环境怎样变化。例如机器人向前推杯子，模型预测杯子接下来会在哪里；智能体还可以比较几种行动的可能结果。预测对象可以是画面，也可以是压缩后的内部状态，关键是这些信息能怎样帮助完成任务。
这里有几条相邻但不同的路线：学习可供控制器使用的环境表示，在模型想象的轨迹里训练策略，或者行动前用模型搜索。生成看起来合理的视频是另一种能力。读论文时，把预测什么、训练谁、最后在哪里测效果分开，会更容易理解它们。
solves: 把高维观察压缩成保留任务信息的表示，帮助策略判断当前处境。
在学到的环境中产生训练轨迹，减少部分真实交互需求。
行动前比较可能的后果，为搜索和规划提供预测。
zh.stance: 判断世界模型是否有用，要看它支持了什么决策，以及模型里的好结果能否回到真实任务中成立。

roadmap.title: 把视觉、记忆与控制拆开
roadmap.text: World Models 用压缩表示和变化预测支持小控制器，并展示在模型生成的环境里训练。

roadmap.title: 为规划学习需要的信息
roadmap.text: MuZero 学习奖励、价值与策略相关的内部状态，用树搜索选行动，不要求把每个未来画面还原出来。

roadmap.title: 在想象轨迹中学习行为
roadmap.text: DreamerV3 的正式论文展示同一套配置如何用于多类任务；重点是世界模型、actor 和 critic 怎样配合。

terms.text: 模型内部保存的压缩表示。它可能包含画面与历史信息，但每个维度未必有可读含义。
预测给定当前状态与行动，下一步状态会怎样变化的模型。
从一个内部状态出发，反复预测行动后果得到的一段轨迹；它的反馈来自模型。
规划在决策时比较候选行动序列；策略直接按观察或内部状态输出动作，二者可以结合。

checklist: 给 World Models 的视觉、记忆、控制三个模块标出输入输出，画出一轮交互。
用一张表比较 MuZero 与 Dreamer：预测哪些量、在哪里训练策略、决策时是否搜索。
对照一段预测与实际轨迹，记录偏差从哪一步开始，以及它可能改变哪个行动选择。
zh.paperIntro: 从 World Models 的交互图开始，再把 MuZero 和 Dreamer 放在一起看：它们需要的预测信息和使用预测的时机不同。

overview: A world model learns how an environment changes from observations and actions. If a robot pushes a cup, it may predict where the cup will move; an agent can compare the consequences of several actions. Predictions may concern images or compressed internal states. Their value depends on how they help a task.

Related routes learn useful representations for controllers, train policies on imagined trajectories, or search with a model before acting. Producing plausible videos is another capability. Keep three questions separate when reading: what is predicted, which component is trained, and where the final outcome is evaluated.
solves: Compress high-dimensional observations into representations useful for decisions.
Generate training trajectories in a learned environment, reducing some real interaction needs.
Predict consequences to support search and planning before acting.
en.stance: Judge a world model by the decisions it supports and whether success inside the model survives evaluation in the actual task.

roadmap.title: Separate vision, memory, and control
roadmap.text: World Models uses compressed observations and dynamics to support a small controller, including training inside a learned environment.

roadmap.title: Learn what planning needs
roadmap.text: MuZero learns internal states for reward, value, and policy prediction, then uses tree search. It need not reconstruct future frames.

roadmap.title: Learn behavior on imagined trajectories
roadmap.text: The formal DreamerV3 paper studies one configuration across task families. Follow how the world model, actor, and critic work together.

terms.text: A compressed internal representation of observations and history. Individual dimensions need not have readable meanings.
A model predicting how the next state depends on the current state and action.
A trajectory generated by repeatedly predicting action outcomes from an internal state. Its feedback comes from the model.
Planning compares candidate action sequences at decision time; a policy maps observations or internal states to actions. They can be combined.

checklist: Label inputs and outputs of the vision, memory, and controller components in World Models; draw one interaction loop.
Compare MuZero and Dreamer in a table: predicted quantities, policy-training location, and search at decision time.
Compare a predicted trajectory with an actual one. Mark where they diverge and which action choice the error might change.
en.paperIntro: Begin with the World Models interaction diagram, then compare MuZero and Dreamer: they need different predictions and use them at different times.

zh.tag: 表示 · 记忆 · 控制
zh.question: 能否先学环境表示，再用很小的控制器完成任务？
zh.idea: 视觉模块压缩画面，循环模型学习变化，控制器利用二者提供的信息选动作。
zh.why: 交互页面让几个模块各自做什么非常直观。
zh.read: 先看 Agent Model 与 Car Racing，再看在 VizDoom 的想象环境中训练。
zh.limit: 控制器可能利用模型误差；模型内高回报需要回到原环境检验。

en.question: Can a learned representation support a small controller?
en.idea: Compress images, learn dynamics with a recurrent model, and feed their representations to a controller.
en.why: The interactive article makes the components tangible.
en.read: Read Agent Model and Car Racing, then the imagined VizDoom experiment.
en.limit: Controllers can exploit model errors; test model-trained behavior in the original environment.

papers.title: Mastering Atari, Go, chess and shogi by planning with a learned model

zh.question: 不知道环境动力学规则时，能否学一个帮助搜索的模型？
zh.idea: 在内部状态里预测奖励、价值与动作策略，用树搜索比较选择。
zh.why: 它说明有用的模型不必还原所有像素，预测目标可以围绕决策来设计。
zh.read: 先看 planning、acting、training 的流程，再看游戏实验。
zh.limit: 论文测试的是特定游戏与动作接口。

en.question: Can a learned model support search without supplied dynamics?
en.idea: Predict reward, value, and policy in internal states, then compare choices with tree search.
en.why: Useful models need not reconstruct every pixel.
en.read: Follow planning, acting, and training before game results.
en.limit: The paper evaluates specific games and action interfaces.

papers.title: Mastering diverse control tasks through world models

zh.question: 怎样让同一套世界模型学习算法适应不同任务的信号尺度？
zh.idea: 用交互经验训练世界模型，在预测轨迹中训练 actor 与 critic，并稳定不同损失与信号的尺度。
zh.why: 它把世界模型与行为学习连起来，也展示跨任务评估应怎样组织。
zh.read: 先看训练流程图与 Learning algorithm，再看任务分组和消融。
zh.limit: 统一配置不等于一个预训练模型直接通吃所有任务；各任务仍需训练与交互。

en.question: How can one algorithm handle different task signal scales?
en.idea: Learn a world model from experience, train actor and critic on imagined trajectories, and stabilize losses and signal scales.
en.why: It connects predictive learning with behavior learning and cross-task evaluation.
en.read: Start with the training diagram, learning algorithm, and ablations.
en.limit: A shared configuration does not mean one pretrained agent solves every task without training.
